builds.desc: Elise is an offensive unit, so her bane would be good for a +atk or +spd. Her defensive capacity is kinda mediocre since she can tank at most one hit. Because of her Weapon it is convinient to have a high speed to deal some extra damage, which is why her passive A must be Swift Sparrow 2 (fortunately she already comes with it) and Darting Blow 3 as her seal, if she's already +spd then maybe you won't need more speed so you can change her seal to anything that you want (I would recomend to increase a bit her defensive capacity to make sure that she tanks that one hit), like giving her distant defense or maybe Attack Smoke.
